requirements.title: Execute Power-On Self-Test at Startup
requirements.description: The system app shall execute a power-on self-test probing each sensor device once during startup.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-029: SYS-APP is the composition-root owner that orchestrates the one-shot POST sequence at boot.

requirements.title: Record Per-Sensor POST Pass-Or-Fail Result
requirements.description: The system app shall record a per-sensor pass-or-fail result from the power-on self-test.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-029: per-sensor POST outcomes are produced by SYS-APP for downstream logging and downlink consumers.

requirements.title: Log POST Result to SD Card
requirements.description: The system app shall log the per-sensor POST result to the SD card once at startup.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-030: SYS-APP is the producer that submits the one-shot POST record to the SD logging path.

requirements.title: Downlink POST Result Over Radio
requirements.description: The system app shall publish the per-sensor POST result for telemetry downlink once at startup.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-056: SYS-APP produces the POST result that the telemetry app downlinks at startup.

requirements.title: Aggregate Sensor Health Into Bitmap
requirements.description: The system app shall aggregate per-sensor health reports from sensor apps into a single health bitmap.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-031: SYS-APP is the central aggregator that combines per-sensor health states for system-wide observability.

requirements.title: Publish Health Bitmap on Software Bus
requirements.description: The system app shall publish the aggregated health bitmap on the software bus continuously throughout the mission.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-031: the bitmap must be available on the bus so telem_app can embed it in every packet.

requirements.title: Drive Operator LED Solid Green When All Healthy
requirements.description: The system app shall drive the operator LED solid green when all sensors report healthy.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-032: SYS-APP owns the LED output and uses the all-healthy aggregate to drive the go indication.

requirements.title: Drive Operator LED Error Pattern on Unhealthy
requirements.description: The system app shall drive the operator LED with an error pattern when any sensor reports unhealthy.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-032: SYS-APP signals no-go to the operator on the pad whenever the aggregate health is degraded.

requirements.title: No Autonomous Reboot During Mission
requirements.description: The system app shall not autonomously reboot or reset the flight software during the mission.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-037: as the lifecycle owner SYS-APP is the only component that could trigger a reboot and must not.

requirements.title: Operational Immediately at Power-On
requirements.description: The system app shall complete startup and begin scheduled execution without waiting for any external arm signal.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-046: SYS-APP as composition root must finish wiring and hand off to the scheduler with no arming gate.

requirements.title: Run Until External Power Removed
requirements.description: The system app shall continue running and never initiate its own shutdown until external power is removed.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-047: SYS-APP owns the lifecycle and must keep the FSW alive until the operator cuts power.

requirements.title: POSIX Build Functional Equivalence
requirements.description: The system app POSIX build shall provide the same observable behavior as the Pico2 flight build.
requirements.rationale: Decomposes SYS-043: SYS-APP must exercise identical lifecycle and POST flows under Trick simulation as on flight hardware.
